create.name: Sue Brayne
create.bio:
Sue Brayne is an English astrologer, writer and podcaster whose work joins astrology with a long engagement with death and dying. Surviving a light aircraft crash some forty years ago set her on that path. She trained as a Life, Death and Transition facilitator with the Elisabeth Kübler-Ross organisation, took master's degrees in the rhetoric and rituals of death and in creative writing, and served as an honorary researcher on Dr. Peter Fenwick's study of end-of-life experiences. She later worked as a therapist and has long facilitated Death Cafés.

She holds the Diploma of the Faculty of Astrological Studies and calls herself a soul astrologer, reading the birth chart for the patterns a life keeps returning to and the direction it is being asked to grow in, while insisting on free will. She gives ninety-minute chart consultations over Zoom to clients in Britain and abroad, interviews fellow astrologers for the Astrological Journal, and hosts the Celebrating Astrology channel on YouTube as well as the Embracing Your Mortality podcast. Her books include Living Fully, Dying Consciously and The D-Word, and she has given a TEDx talk in Frome on facing mortality openly.

books.title: Living Fully, Dying Consciously: The Path to Spiritual Wellbeing
books.author: Sue Brayne
books.description: Brayne argues that a whole life can be seen as psychological and spiritual preparation for its ending, and that meeting the fear of death openly makes for a more conscious way of living. Later chapters turn to consciousness, the transition at death and what may follow it.

books.title: The D-Word: Talking about Dying: A Guide for Relatives, Friends and Carers
books.author: Sue Brayne
books.description: A practical companion for families and carers on starting the hard conversations that come near the end of a life. It draws on her years of end-of-life research and work with the bereaved.

books.title: Nearing the End of Life: A Guide for Relatives and Friends of the Dying
books.author: Sue Brayne
books.description: A short booklet, written with colleagues, that explains what tends to happen as someone moves into the dying process and how those around them can stay present. Its contents also appear on her website's death and dying pages.

courses.title: Astrology Consultation (Zoom)
courses.description: A ninety-minute one-to-one reading of your natal chart over Zoom, with a look at the year ahead through transits, progressions and, time allowing, the solar return. She uses the equal house system and will focus on themes you choose.

free_resources.title: Your Astrology Workbook: A Beginner's Guide
free_resources.description: A free downloadable workbook that walks newcomers through reading their own chart, with exercises for reflection along the way. A small donation is invited but not required.
